data.text: Backend severity/approval/alerts and optional sourcing now implemented and tests pass locally. Adding only named ProcurementAlerts import + <ProcurementAlerts /> before connectionError in current App.tsx; component is self-contained with its own CSS and GET /api/alerts/SSE. Please preserve these two integration lines when merging history/design/twin. No styles.css or other render rewrite by this task. Request.assessment and approval_required are authoritative backend fields. Global require_approval default true; automatic mode also applies confidence, service and NOK thresholds; critical never automatic. docs/procurement.md documents final route/policy shapes.
